title: Android 15 Samsung
text:
Hello,

Based on the Samsung announcement (https://docs.samsungknox.com/dev/knox-sdk/api-reference/restricted-api-methods/), from Android 15 (Knox 3.11) onwards, apps must run as the Android Enterprise Device Owner (DO) of a fully-managed device, or the Profile Owner (PO) of a work profile, to access select Knox SDK features. That means our app, Splashtop Streamer/ SOS, will not be able to access Knox SDK on Android 15 Samsung devices. As a result, the remote screen capture and remote control will not work, as is in your case.

The current workaround is to use devices managed via MDM with the add-on installed. Are you currently using or have you implemented MDM for your devices? If so, please check the following support article for more information: Enable remote control for Android 15 Samsung devices via OEMconfig – Splashtop Business - Support (https://support-splashtopbusiness.splashtop.com/hc/en-us/articles/36971335286299-Enable-remote-control-for-Android-15-Samsung-devices-via-OEMconfig)

Please let us know if you have further questions.

title: MSI Streamer
text:
El hecho de que el Streamer ahora muestre un código de implementación preestablecido ya es una buena señal.

El campo del código de implementación en opaco aparece cuando la aplicación del Streamer no tiene acceso a internet o no puede comunicarse con los servidores de Splashtop durante la instalación

- ¿Podría confirmar qué sucede si el usuario hace clic manualmente en Permitir acceso?

- ¿El streamer inicia sesión correctamente o aparece algún mensaje de error?

- > Si el Streamer inicia sesión correctamente después de hacer clic, esto podría indicar que el equipo no tenía acceso a los servidores de Splashtop durante la instalación, pero lo obtuvo posteriormente.

- > Si el Streamer aún no inicia sesión correctamente después de hacer clic en Permitir acceso, podría significar que todavía existen reglas en la red que impiden que el dispositivo se comunique con los servidores de Splashtop.

¿Podría verificar si la secuencia al plataformar el equipo tal vez se está ejecutando demasiado temprano, es decir, antes de que la red esté completamente disponible, causando que el inicio de sesión de Streamer falle? También hemos visto casos en los que la instalación del Streamer se intenta cuando el equipo está en la pantalla de bloqueo, lo cual puede imponer restricciones de red.

Creo que estamos avanzando en la dirección correcta; solo necesitamos verificar qué está ocurriendo con la red durante la instalación del Streamer.

Por favor, si puede revisar esto con su equipo.

title: OS Patch - Pending Updates Shown
text:
Hello,

I have discussed with the engineering team, and I can provide you with more information on the issue you are encountering.

There is a known limitation with the current Windows Integration. Although endpoints may be fully up to date, the OS Patch Management section might still display certain update, such as older versions, as pending.

The update KB2267602 is very common as it updates the Microsoft Defender data bank, but in some cases, computers already have the newest version of the Microsoft Defender.

We suggest the following in order to clear the update:

- Clear the cache of the browser or try within an incognito window. Then go to the OS Patch page (https://my.splashtop.com/w/os_patch/computer_view/win), select the affected computers, and then select "Check for updates":

- We suggest to check the update history on one of the affected machines and:

- If the version is higher than the one you see on our web console, then you can go to my.splashtop.com/w/os_patch/patch_view (http://my.splashtop.com/w/os_patch/patch_view) and ignore the updates.

Unfortunately, there is not much else our team can offer at the moment.

Please let us know if you have any further questions. Thank You

title: Offline Computer/s
text:
It looks like the computer is grayed out. This usually means the device is either turned off, sleep mode, not connected to the internet, or the Splashtop streamer is not running.

If a computer shows up as offline, you'll need to have someone physically at the computer check the following:

1. Ensure that the computer is powered on

2. Ensure that the computer is not asleep, as network connectivity drops when the computer is asleep

3. Ensure that the computer is connected to internet

4. Check to see if the Streamer at the remote computer is open and running

5. Check to see if the Streamer at the remote computer is logged in under the Status tab

6. Check to see if the Streamer is showing any error messages

Please refer to this article as well:

https://support-splashtopbusiness.splashtop.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402387607707-What-do-I-do-if-my-remote-computer-is-offline-

text:

- Ensure that your firewall or antivirus isn’t blocking the Splashtop Streamer.

- Allow the following domains and ports: What are the Firewall Exceptions and IP addresses of Splashtop servers/Services? (https://support-splashtopbusiness.splashtop.com/hc/en-us/articles/115001811966-What-are-the-Firewall-Exceptions-and-IP-addresses-of-Splashtop-servers-Services)

1. Test with Another Network:

Looking forward to your reply. Thank You!

title: Wake on LAN Splashtop Personal
text:
Hello

Thank you for reaching out to Splashtop Technical Support!

Currently, Splashtop Personal only allows Wake-on-LAN (WoL) within the same network and does not offer remote WoL functionality. We apologize for the inconvenience.

If you require remote WoL capabilities, this feature is available on Splashtop Business Access Pro/Performance. Other requirements also apply, please check the following support article for further details: How do I perform Wake-on-LAN with Splashtop app ? (WoL) – Splashtop Business - Support (https://support-splashtopbusiness.splashtop.com/hc/en-us/articles/212724263-How-do-I-perform-Wake-on-LAN-with-Splashtop-app-WoL)

Again, let us know if you have further questions.
